storyCards.headline: It's So Easy: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Linda Ronstadt's "It's So Easy" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 18 weeks on the chart.

It's So Easy was released in 1977.

Chart story — peaked at #5 on the Hot 100.
